import html from typing import List # Example template; in real usage this would be defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{headline}

Posted by: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html( poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct a secure HTML representation of a forum post. All user supplied content is escaped to prevent XSS or injection attacks. Each tag is wrapped in a element. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str The name of the post's author. headline : str The headline of the user's post. text : str The primary text content of the user's post. hashtags : List[str] A collection of tags related to the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the formatted post. """ # Escape all user supplied fields safe_poster_name = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Build the tags string escaped_tags = [f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in hashtags] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster_name, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=tags_html )
